title: Mradi360
overview: A comprehensive project management site called Mradi360. We built a modern web platform to manage tasks, collaborate in real-time, and track project milestones effortlessly.
overviewSecondary: The system includes Kanban boards, Gantt charts, real-time notifications, and advanced reporting dashboards.
goalsText: The goal was to streamline project workflows and eliminate reliance on scattered tools.
conclusionText: Mradi360 successfully improved team productivity by 40% and centralized project communication for our client.

title: Dukapal
overview: A robust Point of Sale (POS) system called Dukapal designed for modern retail environments, providing seamless checkout experiences and inventory management.
overviewSecondary: Features include multi-store management, offline capabilities, mobile payments integration, and detailed sales analytics.
goalsText: To provide retailers with a fast, reliable, and user-friendly POS that scales with their business.
conclusionText: Dukapal reduced checkout times by 30% and provided merchants with invaluable insights into their daily operations.

title: Afya365
overview: A state-of-the-art Health Management System called Afya365. This platform centralizes patient records, appointment scheduling, and billing for clinics and hospitals.
overviewSecondary: Built with strict security compliance, Afya365 ensures patient data privacy while offering a smooth experience for healthcare professionals.
goalsText: To digitize healthcare administration and improve patient care through better data accessibility.
conclusionText: Afya365 significantly reduced administrative overhead and improved patient satisfaction scores across deployed clinics.

title: Makao360
overview: A comprehensive Rental Management system called Makao360, designed to simplify property management for landlords and agencies.
overviewSecondary: The system automates rent collection, tracks maintenance requests, and provides transparent dashboards for both property owners and tenants.
goalsText: To create a transparent and efficient ecosystem for property management, eliminating manual record-keeping.
goalsBullets: Tenant portal for payments and requests.
conclusionText: Makao360 streamlined property operations, increasing on-time rent collections by 25% and improving tenant-landlord communication.
